---
title: "Cross-reference remark and solution in Typst (#14290)"
keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '#remark\('
          - '#solution\('
          - '<rem-example>'
          - '<sol-exercise>'
          - '#show: show-remark'
          - '#show: show-solution'
          - '#ref\(<rem-example>'
          - '#ref\(<sol-exercise>'
          # unnumbered blocks pin their number and keep the counter still
          - '#remark\(number: "", get-prefix: \(\.\.args\) => text\(weight: "bold", "Remark"\)'
          - '#proof\(number: "", get-prefix: \(\.\.args\) => text\(weight: "bold", "Proof"\)'
          # a numbered proof keeps theorion's own number
          - '#proof\(\)\[(\r\n?|\n)Numbered proof\.'
          # a block holding only a title keeps its label for references
          - '<prf-b>'
        - []
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'Remark\. An unnumbered remark'
          - 'Remark 1 \(A Remark\)'
          - 'Solution 1 \(A Solution\)'
          - 'Proof\. This is an unnumbered proof'
          - 'Proof 1\. Numbered proof'
          - 'Proof \(With code\)\. A named proof'
          - 'Proof 2 \(Only a title\)'
          - 'See Remark 1, Solution 1, Proof 1 and Proof 2'
        -
          - 'Remark 2'
          - 'Proof 3'
          - 'Proof \.'
---

An unnumbered `proof`, `remark` or `solution` block uses the same theorion
frame, and so the same counter, as the numbered block of that kind. It must
show no number and must not move the counter, so that `rem-example` is still
Remark 1 although an unnumbered remark comes before it.

::: {.remark}

An unnumbered remark.

:::

::: {#rem-example}

## A Remark

This is a remark that should be cross-referenceable.

:::

::: {#sol-exercise}

## A Solution

This is a solution that should be cross-referenceable.

:::

::: {.proof}

This is an unnumbered proof.

:::

::: {#prf-a}

Numbered proof.

:::

::: {.proof}

## With `code`

A named proof.

:::

::: {#prf-b}

## Only a title

:::

See @rem-example, @sol-exercise, @prf-a and @prf-b.
